##### Project general facts
DGM Vision is a residential apartment building by Vision Developments, planned around fully furnished homes with smart home technology. The building rises from a ground-floor reception lobby and podium parking levels to residential floors crowned by a roof level. The mix covers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments. On the lowest residential floor, studios and one-bedroom apartments have private pools and large terraces, and the rooftop one-bedroom units also come with private pools. Two-bedroom apartments sit on the upper residential level, and floor-to-ceiling glazing with balconies or terraces runs across the building.

Shared amenities centre on the rooftop, where an infinity pool sits beside a pool deck with sunbeds and a terrace with city views. For fitness and wellbeing, residents have a fully equipped gym, while an air disinfection system and central air conditioning serve the whole building. Leisure and social time take place in the BBQ and picnic area, the social zone and the recreational areas, and families can use a kids' sleep-over snug and nursery. Daily convenience comes from the reception lobby, covered parking with an allocated space for each unit, security with CCTV, concierge service, on-demand housekeeping and on-demand day care.

Apartments are delivered fully furnished, so owners and tenants can move in without sourcing furniture. Interiors feature premium finishes with marble-look surfaces, and kitchens are fitted with built-in Bosch appliances. Every apartment is equipped with a fully automated smart home system and an air quality control system that works alongside the central air conditioning. Floor-to-ceiling glazing draws daylight into the living spaces and opens onto balconies or terraces, and on the private-pool units the large terraces extend the living area outdoors.

##### Location description and benefits
Jumeirah Garden City is a central residential district of Dubai, set close to Sheikh Zayed Road and the established neighbourhood of Al Satwa. The district lies near Downtown Dubai, home to Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and near the Museum of the Future on Sheikh Zayed Road. Zabeel Park, with its jogging track, is close by, while Jumeirah Public Beach and Burj Al Arab are reachable along the coast. Dubai International Airport is a short drive away, which suits residents who travel frequently.

The area combines a prime urban location with a garden-like setting and high-end residences, and its central position gives convenient transport links across the city. Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Wasl Road connect the district with the main business and leisure hubs, and Red Line metro stations run along Sheikh Zayed Road. Shopping and dining are close at hand at The Dubai Mall and City Walk, and the beachfront along Jumeirah adds outdoor options. The community reflects the cultural diversity of Dubai, with residents from many backgrounds.

Proximity to Downtown Dubai, Sheikh Zayed Road and the Jumeirah coastline supports rental demand from professionals who work in the city core and from visitors looking for a central base. Compact furnished apartments in the district suit both long-term leases and short-stay rentals. Garden-like planning and a residential character position Jumeirah Garden City as a central residential alternative to the denser tower districts nearby, with direct access to the main business, retail and leisure destinations of the city.
